name: 陳心怡
objective:
本課程旨在提昇學生撰寫結構完整段落和短文之能力, 並著重如何重寫、摘要、 轉述、 陳述、筆記、編排、起草、修改等相關技巧。
This course is expected to expand students’ writing capacity and experience by helping them to formulate, organize, and present ideas clearly in well-formed paragraphs and compositions. Students will learn about rewriting, outlining, paraphrasing, synthesizing, documenting, note-taking, writing the draft and editing their own work.
課程進度(1-16週):
Weeks 1–7: Unit 1 – Textual Analysis
Developing analytical writing skills through close reading, interpretation, and critical analysis of texts, with emphasis on organization, evidence, and clear academic expression.

Weeks 8–14: Unit 2 – Cultural Analysis
Exploring cultural issues, perspectives, and representations through reading and writing. Students develop critical arguments by connecting texts with broader cultural and social contexts.

Weeks 15–16: Writing Project and Showcase
Integrating skills from both units to complete and present a final analytical writing project.

Weeks 17–18: Flexible Learning Weeks – Reflection and Synthesis
Reflecting on writing development, reviewing feedback and revisions, and identifying strategies for continued growth as critical and independent writers.
彈性學習(17-18週):
類別
		  
		    ● 學生分組實作及討論 (Student group practice and discussion)
● 參與課程相關作業、作品、實驗、田野調查 (Participation in course-related assignments, works, experiments, or field research)
● 線上數位教材學習 (Coursera、edX、磨課師等)(Online digital learning (Coursera, edX, MOOCs, etc.))
● AI 輔助學習與工具應用 (AI-assisted learning and tool application)
		  
      

      
        內容
        
          Reflection and Synthesis
Reflecting on writing development, reviewing feedback and revisions, and identifying strategies for continued growth as critical and independent writers.
        
      

      
        時數 (小時)
        
          6
        
      

      
        學習成果
        
          By the end of the flexible learning weeks, students will be able to:

- Reflect on their development as English writers throughout the course.
- Evaluate their strengths and areas for improvement in textual and cultural analysis.
- Review and revise their writing based on feedback and self-assessment.
- Synthesize key writing strategies and concepts learned throughout the semester.
- Develop strategies for continued growth as critical, reflective, and independent writers.
        
      

      
        評量比例
        
          Assessment for Flexible Learning Weeks (Weeks 17–18): 10%

Students will be assessed based on their active participation in reflection activities, thoughtful review of their writing development, incorporation of feedback into revisions, and completion of a final reflection demonstrating their growth as critical and independent English writers.

延伸教學與資源: ● 混成學習 (Blended Learning) 課程結合實體授課與線上學習（同步視訊／非同步活動）。Combines face-to-face instruction with online learning (including synchronous video sessions or asynchronous activities).● 參與式創新教學 (Participatory & Innovative Teaching) 強調學生參與與產出，導入翻轉、PBL/專題、設計思考或遊戲化等策略。Emphasizes student engagement and outcomes by adopting strategies such as Flipped Classroom, PBL (Problem/Project- Based Learning), Design Thinking, or Gamification.● 數位教材資源應用 (Application of Digital Resources) 採用影音多媒體或具開放授權之資源（如 OCW、開放教科書）作為主要或輔助教材。Adopts multimedia or open-licensed resources (e.g., OCW, Open Textbooks) as primary or supplementary teaching materials.● 數位科技融入 (Digital Technology Integration) 運用生成式 AI、VR/AR、IoT、IRS 等新興科技輔助教學與評量。Utilizes emerging technologies such as Generative AI, VR/AR, IoT, and IRS (Interactive Response Systems) to facilitate teaching and assessment.
